title: A mess to wash, and to use.
text:
A mess to wash, and to use.. Before using this ,I washed both mats that come with this with kitchen soap and a brush.
I used my gas BBQ, only turned on two of the burners, till the temp was about 325 to 350 degrees.
Before puting the fish on the mat, I squeezed lemon on the mat, and sprinkled seasoning on.
Put two different kinds of wild fillet fish on. Threw the package out, so don't remember what kind it was.

When I went back to check after 6 mins, the thicker white fish had allot of this foaming stuff coming out of it!! But was not ready to turn over.,
Neither was the thinner fish...
Using the mat, it took longer for the fish to cook, although from reading other reviews, I was afraid to turn my BBQ to high.

When I finally turned the thicker fish over, it still continued to have this foaming stuff coming out of the fish. Didnt look like anytype of fish fat to me!
Btw I have cooked that fish on a skillet inside the house on my gas stove before, and Never has it had this foamy stuff that kept coming out of it!

As far as washing this mat, for me it was a Pain. I now had dinner dishes in tne sink, and the mat had all this black mess stuck to it that I didnt want in my dishwasher.
I had to lay it on my granite counter, and scrub it with kitchen soap, and a kitchen bush on both sides.
It took some scrubing to get that stuff off.

I'm only going to give this a try again,using vegetables ..

For me I could have used a ceramic non stick skille for the fish, and it would have cooked faster, and Much easier, and faster to wash.
That said, it was 105 degrees in Ca. Today, but with the air going in the house, and a shorter amout of time
To cook this in my house with the stove hood fan on, it would have worked out better for me.or just use my George formen grill.

If I get a different result I'll up date..
